publication: Published on 2026-11-17 after explicit user approval: one new map and 23 child issues with native parent/blocking relationships. Implementation remains separately authorized; newly discovered custom codec work still requires consultation.

approved.scope: Reuse the current Unicode conversion tables for ISO-8859-10/11/14/16 in Rust with bounded lookup/reverse lookup
Proposal A: selected JIS/EUC repertoire and reverse choices, Japanese kana and JIS designation/state policy in Rust over a planned native Microsoft CP932 base
Proposal B: specified shared receive recovery and exact whole-send preflight policy in Rust

codecConsultation.remainingCodePages: Static assessment completed 2026-11-17: native Microsoft conversion plus approved shared policy for the other 37 single-byte identities and CP936/949/950; no additional identity-specific table or patch identified
codecConsultation.verification: Native exactness and supported-platform availability are future implementation acceptance checks, not verified by the static review
codecConsultation.excluded: No speculative port of managed CP932 overrides or other new mapping corrections/data; consult separately if a concrete native mismatch requires them

tickets.title: Establish the native-only UTF-8 integration baseline
tickets.delivers: Capture a reproducible baseline and run the existing basic UTF-8 profile/session/display path using the candidate native integration.

tickets.title: Share interpretation and admit complete native operations
tickets.delivers: Use one interpretation definition for Estimate and Execute, with bounded admission, owned results and rejection before native mutation.

tickets.title: Submit native UTF-8 input with committed local echo
tickets.delivers: Send input and pasted text through strict native preparation, with local echo committed only at the accepted send boundary.

tickets.title: Complete native normal-screen editing and rendition
tickets.delivers: Render and copy contracted normal-screen editing, scrolling, tabs, character sets, colors and Unicode clusters from Rust.

tickets.title: Run alternate-screen applications with native input modes
tickets.delivers: Run full-screen terminal interactions with alternate screens, resets, replies, application keys and mouse modes in Rust.

tickets.title: Resize native normal and parked terminal output
tickets.delivers: Resize and restore output without leaving Rust, preserving reflow, anchors, clusters and recording provenance.

tickets.title: Use all single-byte encodings in native sessions
tickets.delivers: Receive and strictly transmit the 41 single-byte encoding identities through actual profile/session paths.

tickets.title: Use native Chinese and Korean multibyte encodings
tickets.delivers: Use cp936, cp949 and cp950 in native receive/transmit with exact mappings, split-input and malformed-unit behavior.

tickets.title: Use native CP932 and EUC-JP terminal encoding
tickets.delivers: Use CP932 and EUC-JP with the accepted Japanese mappings, kana and strict transmit behavior.

tickets.title: Use native stateful JIS terminal encoding
tickets.delivers: Keep JIS receive/transmit and paced-paste closure state inside Rust, preserving source independence and exact byte order.

tickets.title: Own complete native recording interval operations
tickets.delivers: Start, pause, resume and abort recording through complete terminal operations and real files without caller-owned repair.

tickets.title: Record edited native normal-screen Text across intervals
tickets.delivers: Write receive-only normal-screen Text with the accepted editing, line, retirement, tab and pause/resume rules.

tickets.title: Record native alternate Text and canonical Terminal operations
tickets.delivers: Write alternate-screen Text and combined canonical Terminal output across screen, source and recording-interval transitions.

tickets.title: Keep recording files and native state consistent through failures
tickets.delivers: Handle opening, retry, cancellation and write/flush failure across all format selections while preserving healthy native terminal work.

tickets.title: Read retained native output through presentation and history APIs
tickets.delivers: Render, copy, expose UIA and capture screen/history using owned Rust results, including retained disconnected output.

tickets.title: Search and publish native terminal history consistently
tickets.delivers: Use native bounded search and revision/retention evidence through the existing ordered AI publication path.

tickets.title: Preserve transfer cleanup outcomes when a terminal closes
tickets.delivers: Report transfer-window cleanup outcomes through the existing visible close paths while retaining actual provider ownership.

tickets.title: Close a terminal tab through one owned operation
tickets.delivers: Own a single tab's confirmation, termination, waiting, cleanup outcome and visual removal through one operation.

tickets.title: Close windows by joining existing tab closures
tickets.delivers: Join already closing tabs, confirm remaining targets and close the window without duplicate work or a second click.

tickets.title: Close disconnected tabs and their transfer windows consistently
tickets.delivers: Use the complete closure workflow for bulk and automatic removal, including associated transfer windows and required reporting.

tickets.title: Retain native terminal state until final tab removal
tickets.delivers: Retain Rust output after disconnect and release its owner on final removal while independent results and I/O keep their lifetimes.

tickets.title: Integrate the complete native-only terminal candidate
tickets.delivers: Integrate all 48 encodings and terminal/recording/observation/closure paths, remove production managed selection and verify native-only behavior.

tickets.title: Validate native terminal deployment and acceptance workloads
tickets.delivers: Verify deployment, actual integration, presentation and measured response/memory workloads for the complete candidate.
